summary: OKKAX iteration 2 verification. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py — Google auth endpoint guard (missing header→400, bogus session→401, no user created), Stripe test-mode checkout creates cs_test_* session with checkout.stripe.com URL and IDR→USD note, no ticket issued and tier.sold unchanged pre-payment, status polling returns pending/initiated and stays idempotent across 3 calls, unknown session_id→404, role workspace returns proper sections for talent/venue/vendor/worker/finance/supervisor (audience empty), self-confirm persists across reload, cross-owner confirm 403, PDF documents (invoice/quotation/payment-schedule) return application/pdf attachment with OKKAX-* filename >1KB, authorization enforced (audience 403 on quotation; other user 403 on invoice), sandbox regression (VA→simulate→ticket issued) works, demo/reset seeds linked_talent_ids/linked_venue_id/linked_vendor_id/linked_worker_id on the demo users. Frontend Playwright: google-login-btn on /login and google-register-btn on /register present, AuthCallback with dummy hash shows auth-callback-error (401 handled without crash), /checkout page shows both pay-mode-sandbox and pay-mode-stripe, selecting Stripe reveals stripe-note and changes submit button text to 'Bayar dengan kartu (Stripe test)'; /app/me shows role-section-talent / -venue / -finance and sidebar side-my-assignments; talent-confirm-<id> click hits POST /api/me/workspace/confirm 200; MyOrders shows invoice-btn-* and clicking downloads application/pdf 200; /app/events/evt-aruna-2026/overview shows download-quotation-btn + download-schedule-btn and both stream application/pdf 200. Stripe live card checkout (4242…) was NOT completed (out of scope for automated harness).
critical_code_review_comments: extras.py fulfill_stripe_order() computes ticket_number from db.tickets.count_documents() which is race-prone under concurrent fulfillment — for competition demo it's fine, but a monotonic counter (or unique index + upsert) would be safer.

stripe_status() catches Exception broadly and only logs at WARNING — an actual paid session that fails to fetch would silently stay 'pending' until next poll. Acceptable given webhook fallback but worth an explicit retry policy.

google_session() sets cookie with SameSite=None,Secure but frontend still relies on Authorization: Bearer from JSON body — cookie is effectively unused. Either drop the cookie set or wire /auth/me to accept it — dead code otherwise.
IDR_PER_USD hardcoded as env with default 16000 — flag inside the note is good, but consider surfacing rate & timestamp to the UI so audience sees the conversion transparently.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iteration-2 UI selectors present and integrated with backend APIs)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/demo/reset invoked at session start; no other seed created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (24 tests, ~12s under xdist loadscope). Iteration-1 file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (27 tests). Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and rely on POST /api/demo/reset for baseline. STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' in .env works for the emergentintegrations wrapper — creates real cs_test_* sessions on Stripe test mode. Do not attempt full card payment via automation — Stripe blocks headless. UI tabs for EventWorkspace are dynamic; use /app/events/<id>/overview to find download-quotation-btn + download-schedule-btn. Role workspace path is /app/me (not /app/dashboard).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iteration 2 features.
